designs.note: Most baobab-like of the four (massive columnar trunk, short crooked branches); pen instead of line keeps the bark lines; 5100/5101 generic broad-crowned trees.
No seed drew olive leaves (all needle tufts), so titled GNARLED TREE by the truth rule; 5200 the most twisted, knotted trunk, whole in the page; pen mode.
Clear weeping willow, whole in the page on its own patch of grass; 5301/5302 landscape behind, 5300 crown and meadow cut at the edge; pen mode.
Twisting pine in bonsai style on a rock, no pot, whole in the page; 5401 stray plant on its slab, 5402/5403 green tint; pen mode.
No dates or leaf-base trunk drawn, so titled PALM TREE by the truth rule; 5501/5502 horizon across the page, 5500 signature mark; pen had too much ink, line passes.

minutes_note: Generation 15:56-17:07 on 4 CPU threads (about 3 min an image, 20 images); the first run was killed by the container's memory limit after 2 images while a test oneink ran beside the VAE decode, and was restarted at 16:07 on the remaining 18. Choosing and one-ink processing ran during generation as each slot landed; process counts only the time after the last image.
lesson: For trees, pen keeps the pale bark and needle lines that line mode drops; a full palm crown has too much ink in pen but passes in line. The model gave pine-needle foliage to the olive and no dates on the date palm, so those two carry general titles.
